class.name: VADefaultMaterial
class.description: Overrides the acoustic properties of one of the SDK's built-in materials for the level's [VAWorld]. Must be added as a child of (or alongside) the level's [VAWorld].

members.member: Which built-in material to override. Changing this resets the properties below to that material's own defaults.
The percentage of low-frequency energy that is lost when a ray bounces off this material.
The percentage of high-frequency energy that is lost when a ray bounces off this material.
The scattering strength when a ray bounces off this material. 0.0 means no scattering, 1.0 skews the ray's reflection direction by up to 90 degrees.
How many meters a ray must travel through this material before it loses all low-frequency energy.
How many meters a ray must travel through this material before it loses all high-frequency energy.
The percentage of low-frequency energy that is lost when a permeation ray passes through a flat (plane, disk, triangle, or non-watertight mesh) surface using this material.
The percentage of high-frequency energy that is lost when a permeation ray passes through a flat (plane, disk, triangle, or non-watertight mesh) surface using this material.
The debug rendering color for this material (dev build only).
